about_the_game:
Test and refine your surgical expertise in foreign environments, utilizing advanced, futuristic tools that still feel intuitively familiar.

The Alien Surgery Expansion Pack introduces 12 brand new surgery levels, each offering unique challenges that will push even the most seasoned surgeons to their limits. Alongside these gripping new scenarios, you’ll have access to 5 cutting-edge tools, each designed to tackle complex tasks in ways you’ve never seen before. From delicate procedures like cutting veins and controlling blood flow, to the intricate task of arranging advanced circuit boards in precise orientations, this expansion pack offers an exciting mix of both surgical precision and strategic thinking.

Prepare to face situations that are truly out of this world, testing your skills with innovative technology and a host of challenges that require more than just medical expertise. Whether you're removing infectious growth or repairing alien technology to save lives, every level offers a fresh test of your abilities, demanding adaptability and a quick thinking mind. The Alien Surgery Expansion Pack is a must-have for anyone seeking to expand their surgical prowess to new frontiers.
